subject: Re: Executive join — CTO travel delay, request to split briefing + demo
messages:
From: Alex Bennett <abennett@nimbushealth.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: Nimbus Health Sales Ops <salesops@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Request: CTO flight delayed — can we split the session and have VP join?

Hi Irene,

Quick note — our CTO's flight just got delayed and he won't make the 2:00 PM ET slot for the full technical demo today. Our VP of Engineering (Olivia Park) can get on for the last 30 minutes, but we'd prefer a short executive briefing beforehand so the VP can see the strategic value without the deep infra minutiae.

Can your team split the session into:
- 30-minute executive briefing at 1:45 PM ET (high-level value + cost/ROI + security controls)
- 60-minute technical demo at 2:30 PM ET (deep dive + Q&A)

If you can’t do a split, our other option is to move the whole demo to tomorrow morning 10:00 AM ET. We realize this is last-minute — appreciate any flexibility.

Attaching our preferred agenda and the contact who will join from our side.

Thanks,
Alex Bennett
Head of Solutions — Nimbus Health
abennett@nimbushealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: agenda_request.pdf (application/pdf)
From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: Alex Bennett <abennett@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-05T10:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Request: CTO flight delayed — can we split the session and have VP join?

Alex — thanks for the heads up and sorry to hear about the CTO's travel. We can do a split session today; below is a proposed plan that minimizes context switching for both teams.

Proposed schedule (today):
- 1:40 PM ET — Exec briefing (20–30 min). Presenters: Irene (product) + Karthik (solutions). Focus: outcomes, high-level perf/cost, security/compliance bullets.
- 2:10 PM ET — Short break / internal handoff (20 min).
- 2:30 PM ET — Technical demo (60 min). Presenters: Marissa (engineering lead) + Jordan (CS). Focus: architecture, latency/cost numbers, model failover policy.

Operational notes & asks:
- Jordan will act as the primary demo runner for the technical session and can cover any follow-ups if the CTO needs a 1:1 later.
- We’ll record both segments and share a time-stamped highlight reel for the CTO.
- Please confirm who will join the exec briefing (VP + any PMs) so we can tailor the bullets.

I’ve attached an updated agenda and a short executive slide deck. If you prefer tomorrow at 10:00 AM ET, we can do that as a fallback — but the split today gives the VP immediate context and preserves your team's calendar.

Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Manager — Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
(415) 555-0134

Attachments: Redwood_demo_agenda_v2.pdf (application/pdf); executive_briefing_slide_deck.pptx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation)

All — quick operational add from infra/ops perspective. If we split, please note the following so we don't get pulled between rooms: 

- Engineering presence: Marissa will lead the demo but we should have an engineer on standby for live perf numbers (I can be on call if needed).
- Canary plan: if the VP asks for a production-level perf check, we should show pre-recorded traces rather than run live against the production endpoint.
- Recording & notes: Jordan, please ensure the recording starts for the exec segment (short highlights) and add timestamps for the handoff.

Irene — I support the split plan. If the external team confirms VP-only for the exec slot, let's tighten that briefing to 20 minutes.

Karthik Iyer
VP, Product — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Thanks, Irene & team — splitting works for us. Confirmation:
- Exec briefing: 1:40 PM ET, VP Olivia Park + Head of IT (Daniel Cho) will join. Please keep it to 20 minutes.
- Technical demo: 2:30 PM ET — full team. CTO will join remotely if his flight lands in time; if not, we’ll review the recording.

I’ve accepted the updated calendar invite (attached) and uploaded a one-page doc with the VP's priority checklist to the shared drive (link below). Jordan — please use the checklist to shape the 20-minute briefing.

Appreciate the flexibility. If anything changes on our side I’ll ping you immediately.

Best,
Alex
